lead.headline: DTCC and Mirae Asset push tokenized securities into institutional workflows as stablecoin infrastructure reaches scale
lead.tldr: Today's signals trace a single arc: the plumbing between traditional finance and on-chain markets is being installed by incumbents, not disruptors. For investors underwriting the tokenization thesis, the question is no longer whether institutions adopt digital rails, but which chains and intermediaries capture the value.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Coinbase adds Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin across retail, exchange and Prime platforms
top_signals.summary: Coinbase has integrated Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin across its retail app, exchange, and Prime platforms. The integration allows for 1:1 USD conversion across the XRP Ledger, Ethereum, and Base networks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Coinbase listing RLUSD across retail, exchange and Prime creates a distribution moat that Ripple's own stablecoin lacked; for investors, this tests whether RLUSD can capture meaningful share from USDC/USDT or merely splits XRP ecosystem liquidity.

top_signals.title: DTCC unit launches tokenization services
top_signals.summary: DTCC has launched tokenization services via a subsidiary to facilitate the adoption of tokenized securities. The initiative aims to provide a practical framework for integrating digital assets into traditional financial markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: DTCC entering tokenization services signals that post-trade infrastructure incumbents intend to intermediate digital asset settlement, potentially capturing value that blockchain-native protocols had assumed would accrue to smart contract platforms.

top_signals.title: Ripple expects $900 million annualized product revenue run rate as institutional business expands
top_signals.summary: Ripple expects its annualized product revenue run rate to reach $900 million as its institutional business continues to expand. The company reports a tripling of customers using multiple products and lifetime payment network volume approaching $150 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Ripple's $900 million product revenue run rate and tripling of multi-product customers suggests its institutional payments business has reached sufficient scale to underwrite a stablecoin strategy independently of XRP price performance.

top_signals.title: Mirae Asset Securities issues tokenized notes on Solana
top_signals.summary: Mirae Asset Securities' Hong Kong unit has issued six-month tokenized notes on the Solana blockchain. The offering was specifically targeted toward institutional investors, marking a significant step in the adoption of RWA tokenization by major financial institutions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Mirae Asset Securities issuing tokenized notes on Solana for institutional investors is a concrete data point that Korean financial conglomerates are evaluating non-Ethereum chains for RWA issuance, repricing Solana's enterprise credibility.

top_signals.title: Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police28m
top_signals.summary: Singapore police report that users lost $2.7 million after purchasing tampered Ledger hardware wallets. The scams involved modified devices that allowed attackers to steal private keys and drain funds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $2.7 million Ledger tampering losses expose a persistent gap in hardware wallet supply chain verification that undermines self-custody adoption curves and creates regulatory pressure points for wallet providers and exchanges alike.

on_the_radar.title: Phantom launches Kalshi-powered prediction markets for US users 10m
on_the_radar.summary: Phantom has integrated Kalshi-powered prediction markets, allowing its US-based users to trade on real-world events. This move bridges the gap between a popular Web3 wallet and a regulated prediction market platform.

on_the_radar.title: Google Cloud outlines MPC service for institutional Bitcoin custody
on_the_radar.summary: Google Cloud has updated its Multi-Party Computation (MPC) service documentation to better support institutional Bitcoin custody. This update comes ahead of a New York symposium focused on crypto security and institutional asset management.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase denies systems breach, says vendor exposed customer data41m
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase has denied a direct breach of its own internal systems following reports of customer data exposure. The company clarified that the data leak originated from a third-party vendor rather than its own infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: EtherFi: Banking on Growth
on_the_radar.summary: EtherFi is implementing a 'neobank' strategy on-chain by utilizing its card to offer credit, swaps, and memberships. The analysis examines the protocol's growth trajectory and the mechanics of its new token buyback program.

on_the_radar.title: Avail launches ShieldTX privacy tool targeting copy-trading bots on Hyperliquid
on_the_radar.summary: Avail has launched ShieldTX, a privacy tool designed to protect traders on Hyperliquid from copy-trading bots. The tool aims to mitigate the financial losses traders incur when their strategies are mirrored by bots.

on_the_radar.title: Crypto braces for potential shift in congressional oversight after midterms
on_the_radar.summary: The crypto industry is preparing for a potential shift in legislative dynamics following the midterms. Sources suggest that a Democratic majority in Congress could alter the approach to crypto oversight.

on_the_radar.title: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen aims to enter the U.S. market in 2027, with or without the CLARITY Act
on_the_radar.summary: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen has announced plans to enter the U.S. market by 2027. This ambition persists despite the failure of the CLARITY Act to pass in the U.S. Senate.

on_the_radar.title: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’
on_the_radar.summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev argues that current regulatory uncertainty in the US is preventing institutional assets from moving on-chain. While acknowledging a temporary SEC exemption, he emphasizes the need for clear legislation to build investor confidence.

worth_a_read.title: EtherFi: Banking on Growth
worth_a_read.note: Messari's EtherFi analysis examines how restaking protocols are evolving from yield farming vehicles toward structured product platforms, relevant for investors tracking the maturation of EigenLayer's ecosystem.

worth_a_read.note: Galaxy's Q3 venture capital data provides the actual financing decline figures that founders and investors need to calibrate round timing and valuation expectations against a cooling late-stage market.

linkedin_post:
DTCC does not launch subsidiaries for experiments. When the entity that clears virtually all US equity trades builds tokenization services, it is because the buy-side has asked for settlement infrastructure that speaks to both ledgers and legacy systems. That is the throughline today: Mirae Asset's Solana notes, Ripple's $900 million run rate, Coinbase listing RLUSD across every product tier. Institutions are not speculating on crypto. They are installing plumbing.

The repricing question for us is where value accrues. DTCC as intermediary can extract rents that blockchain protocols assumed would vanish. Solana gains credibility with Korean issuers, but Ethereum retains DTCC's implicit endorsement through existing integration paths. Ripple's stablecoin finally has distribution, yet its revenue is still overwhelmingly payments-driven—the stablecoin is a hedge, not the core underwritable business.

What would kill this read: DTCC's tokenization services remain pilot-stage for eighteen months with no material asset volume. What confirms it: a major fund complex announcing tokenized share classes with DTCC as the sole transfer agent. We are watching for that announcement. Not because it is inevitable. Because it is the test.
